fx.d: Slow creep onto her face, hard snap on a key word
Camera dives through her and cuts to a tighter framing
Lights cut on a line, snap back
Giant words march behind her and swap on the word she says
Wall behind her fills with scrolling headline cards
Grid of cover tiles on the wall behind her
Name tiles slam on, then are knocked out one by one
Room goes dark, she stays lit, key words land in gold
Cards circle her, passing behind and in front
Copies of her pop up beside her on her words
Her clip shrinks into a gold-rimmed card, she pops out
An app screen fills the frame, she steps back in front of it
Full-screen plate (text or screenshot), she shrinks to the bottom
Freeze frame becomes a die-cut sticker with handwritten notes
Data cards with racing bars (lower third)
Copper tag above her cap that follows her
Picture freezes, labels point at her
3D phone flies in beside her
Steps tick off as she says them (lower third)
Cards tied to her by lines that follow her
Numbers roll digit by digit
Wipe line turns the raw look into the edit
A chart draws and ends on a gold label
The keyword types itself, posts, reply with link lands
An editing timeline builds, then catches fire
Her clip shrinks into an editing app window and gets cut
Camera starts tight and eases out to normal framing (keep from near 1.10 on 720p sources)
One or two frames of white (or warm) like a camera flash
Holds the frame while a line of gold text lands. Her voice keeps playing, so use it on a pause
Color look over her frame: golden-hour, blue-hour, warm, cool
Soft bloom on the highlights
Drifting warm dust particles
Cinema bars top and bottom that slide in and out
Voice-memo card with a copper waveform that moves while she speaks (driven by her word timings, not a true audio spectrum)
A photo with handwritten caption drops in and lands. Give it src, or it shows "photo goes here"
A notes page with lines that type in on her words
An email types itself and sends
A phone lock-screen notification slides in over the scene
A small stamp like "Tuesday, 4:20 PM" in a corner
Behind her: torn paper sheets in kraft, cream or crimson with hard cut-paper shadows that jitter like stop motion. Optional label becomes a ransom-note strip of paper letters. Needs the matte

Over her: hand-drawn marks that draw on and wobble 8 times a second. Marks: circle, underline, arrow, star, burst, heart, text, each pinned to head, chest and so on, with optional handwritten text and white, gold or red ink
Behind her: the dolly-zoom feel. She holds her size while the room stretches and blurs away (to 1.1 to 2, direction in or out). Needs the matte
Behind her: a magazine cover. Masthead, issue line and cover lines, her head in front of the masthead, a big headline and barcode in front. Needs the matte
Over her: frosted-glass lettering that blurs the room under it, one word at a time (words with at, y as a fraction of the frame, default low on the desk)
A white bar types a line, the crimson send button presses, then it flips to a "Done" state with a copper check
A comment field types the keyword, Post, the comment lands with a heart, a dark reply card arrives (optional link chip)
The same field with an instruction line above it
A file card drops into a dashed drop zone and settles with a check
A generic app tile gets a crimson strike, then the C3 mark pops in beside it
An "Edit mode" tray of wiggling app tiles where the unwanted ones are deleted and the kept one centers

A fan of three cards: a script page with numbered lines and two real freeze frames from her clip (stills seconds). The cards fly: fly is orbit (default, loop around the screen then land in the fan), swoop or off
A big copper serif word whose letters fall and bounce into place, with an optional italic kicker (turn captions off for that moment, the kicker sits in the caption band)
A slider card whose knob moves while a warm, cool or golden grade fades in over the frame
An eyedropper picks a brand swatch (pick index) and the frame grades toward it
A stack of up to four lines that rise through a mask one after another, mixing serif, bold sans and copper italic (set captions: "off" on that segment)
One huge word on a dark block with a copper italic accent line under it (captions off for that moment)
A row of three or four small portrait tiles that each play a different moment of her own clip (offsets) and pop in with a tilt. fly: swoop or orbit (default off)
A white card with a copper rim: her clip playing, a progress bar, a serif title and a small sub line
A scroll-blur takeover into a reel-style screen: her clip playing, handle and brand mark, and the like, comment, share and save rail (captions off)
Three to six video cards of her own clip circle the screen with depth, tilt and a stagger. Stack it with reel-feed for a feed with cards flying around it
A "HELLO my name is" tag with a handwritten name
A weekly planner fills with colored blocks, then clears to a copper italic word ("free")
A field opens a list, the pointer picks an option, a copper check lands
A dark knob turns from low to max with labeled ticks
A typeface card: big "Aa", the font name and a role line
A card of lines where a pencil strikes one out in crimson
A rubber stamp slams down at an angle ("NEXT WEEK")
A numbered list where your row highlights, writes "you" and checks
An envelope with a copper wax seal opens and a document card rises out
Up to three comment cards slide in one after another (real comments only). fly: swoop arcs them in (default off)
A rendering card with a progress bar and thumbnails of her clip filling in
A note card from the brand mark that types a feedback line
A ranked list where the first row glows copper with a trophy
A ring timer that counts up or down with a unit and label
A dark terminal window typing command lines
A tile row with a switch that flips on to "Connected"
Shimmering "Generating" tiles resolve into your lab objects. fly: swoop arcs the tiles in (default off)
A profile pill where Follow flips to Following
The whole frame blurs and refocuses, a soft transition between beats
Reel cards of her clip in perspective, each with a "Link copied" chip. fly: swoop arcs the cards in (default off)
A torn-edge slip prints from a slot under the captions, types your text, then shows TOTAL, 1 SENTENCE. The timecode line is the real time in the video
Full cutaway: a 30-day grid fills with copper tiles and a few real frames of her clip (thumbs)
A white magazine page: copper masthead, her clip as the cover photo, a barcode and a headline. issue is `left
Editing-shortcut keys fall, bounce and pile up low on the screen
Two strips of her own frames on a white card. marks circles or crosses out frames with a pen stroke, with an optional handwritten label
Her clip shrinks into a phone bezel on a solid field. Different from phone-mockup, which sits at the side
Giant letters (word, use / for line breaks) with her clip playing inside them. field is white or black
A row (or two) of small numbered cards of her clip fly in and pin low on the screen
One numbered chip at a time ("01 The raw take"), each timed by steps[].at
A hand-drawn crimson ring around her head (follows the matte anchors), an arrow and a handwritten note, with a black-and-white grade

One to three cards turn over in 3D. The front shows your own words (front), the back shows her clip at the second you set (from) with an optional small back label. flipAt sets when the first one turns; the others follow a beat later. Lab plan: content/fxlab17.
A true 3D ring of her own clip cards that turns in perspective: the front card faces you and the side cards foreshorten as they pass. Props tiles, cy, radius, width, spinSec, tiltX

Behind her (needs the matte): a dark script document scrolls across the screen while she steps to the lower left. beats hold your real lines (quote, optional time, label, notes) and steps show numbered chips on her words. Lab plan: content/fxlab15.scene.json,
Each line steps up in size ("and the / captions / come / in"), the last in copper
A named cursor draws a box on the head, then pulls it out to a big rectangle (any width/height), with a live size readout and a center guide.
Copies of the speaker fan out in a row behind them, smaller toward the edges.
A cream clock face swings in behind them; the hand ticks through the days.
A phone keyboard types the words with a suggestion bar.
The letters of a word circle the head, passing behind and in front.
The room goes dark and code scrolls across the speaker.
A feed of post tiles (images, quotes) fills in behind them while a counter climbs.
The clip plays inside a giant serif word, then the camera dives into one letter.
A white comment box types a keyword, posts it, a heart pops, a reply drops in.
The frame splits into 3D glass layers: room, speaker, title, sound.
A notebook page behind them: a handwritten word, then a big inked word with an underline.
A white line flashes across, the frame is cut along it and the top half slides off and snaps back (slide px).
Label tiles drop and pile up on the head.
Soft shapes sharp in the foreground, then focus racks to the speaker.
A full-screen green currency note with the speaker engraved in the oval; the number counts up.
A chat voice message records with a live waveform, sends, reads Delivered.
Comic panel: hard black ink on cream, speed lines, a double flash and one huge word.
The speaker holds still while the room recedes behind them.
A newspaper front page with a halftone photo and the headline.
A printed page rips down the middle and flies apart to reveal the speaker.
The speaker dissolves into dust that drifts off (plate: a still of the empty set reveals the empty room).
Words hang in the room at different depths, some behind and some in front.
A frosted glass panel floats in 3D in front of them with an orb and a progress bar.
The frame breaks into shards that pop toward camera, then settle back.
A big serif word sits in the room behind the speaker.

A short line of text pops in and has its own exit. look: focus, shiny, gradient, blur-in (default), split, glitch, scramble, badge (rising title with ribbon; sub, tag), glass (puffy bubble letters), fill, stack (line2, line3). y and size move and scale it
A frosted card with a number that counts up (value, prefix, suffix, label, sub). Real numbers only
A list with switches. Give every item {"text": "...", "at": <second>} so each switch turns on at its own word. This is not a checklist
Two options side by side (left, right, leftText, rightText); the winner gets a badge
A line graph draws through your points and lands on a labeled value. Real numbers only
A document card for your lead magnet with a Comment "keyword" pill
A handwritten note with a curved arrow pointing at to: [x, y]. The arrow starts outside the note on the side facing its target; from and bend adjust it
The shot pushes in and slides her to one side; numbered step cards float beside her in depth, each on its own second
A round iris closes to a circle on her face, holds (optional word), and opens again. mode: peek, close or open
Hard cuts between framings with her face pinned to the same spot, a white flash and an optional big word per cut (mono makes a cut black and white)
An app window floats in; a cursor glides to the button and clicks it, and the button turns to done. src swaps in a real screenshot
Small frosted cards float around her and bob, each with a label, a value and an optional bar
Opens as a close-up of a pixel screen (red, green, blue stripes), then pulls back and sharpens into her clip
Up to three reels spin and stop one by one on her words, then the frame glows
A see-through hologram phone turns beside her, with scan lines, glow and a light cone
She turns into a dark silhouette on a color field, a big word lands behind her, then a light sweep brings her back
A grid of pictures rises in tile by tile, with a title and an optional Comment "WORD" pill
A stack of 2 to 5 tilted frames fans out like a hand of cards
A clip or picture in a white frame beside her, with up to 4 handwritten notes and arrows (leave media out to frame her own clip)
Two of the member's pictures or clips with labels; the winner lifts and glows
A question with two answers; one gets picked
Her whole picture in two colors (dark, light)
One huge number that counts up, poster style, with a label and a line under it. Real numbers only
The picture goes black and white and a handwritten line writes on, with an underline
Big type lying on the wall in perspective behind her; the shot eases down to make room above her head
Illustrated examples of what she says (replies, a name spelled right, reactions, holidays, a newcomer, five rules, someone left out), headed by her exact words as she says them.
Small spaced-caps label at the top of a scene
Card with a headline, optionally struck through on a word
An old line struck through, then the new line writes in
Stack of app notifications arriving
Center node with spokes that change state (waiting to agreeing)
Chat window with messages arriving by channel
Video-meeting tile with participants and a muted moment
Chips drifting around her, or stacked large when she is hidden
Numbered chapter title with a short flow of steps
Four-part map with links and a pulse
Notes card with lines that check off
Community post sitting unanswered, with a status line
Source card: authors, year, title, journal
A real screenshot as a card or full screen, with slow pan
Big statement whose words pop in as she says them (the graphic becomes the caption)

jobs.name: Hook openers
jobs.desc: Stop the scroll in the first two seconds.

jobs.name: Words on screen
jobs.desc: Put a key line or word in front of the viewer.

jobs.name: Show an example
jobs.desc: Show the thing you are talking about: a chat, a post, a screen.

jobs.name: Lists and steps
jobs.desc: Walk through points, steps or a framework.

jobs.name: Numbers and proof
jobs.desc: Back a point with a number, a source or a comparison. Real numbers only.

jobs.name: Behind you
jobs.desc: The wall behind the presenter comes alive. Needs the cutout.

jobs.name: Camera moves and looks
jobs.desc: Move the shot, cut with energy, set the mood.

jobs.name: Paper and handmade
jobs.desc: Notes, stickers, polaroids and things that feel made by hand.

jobs.name: Cards in motion
jobs.desc: Cards, tiles and screens that flip, spin and stack.

jobs.name: Calls to action and endings
jobs.desc: Close the video and ask for the next step.
